title: Stablecoin Reserve 3-Source Recompute
description: Recomputes reserve ratio, weighted-average maturity, and per-holding GENIUS eligible-asset match from three independently-sourced legs (issuer disclosure with a per-asset-class breakdown, EDGAR N-MFP Part 1 series summary, declared on-chain supply), then reconciles them against each other, skew-gated on how far apart their as-of dates are. Each leg is optional; a missing leg drives every check that depends on it to INDETERMINATE, never a fabricated pass. Reserve-ratio and WAM-ceiling checks use MET/NOT_MET/INDETERMINATE vocabulary; per-holding GENIUS eligible-asset flags use MATCHES_CRITERION/DOES_NOT_MATCH/INDETERMINATE (the statutory catch-all item always INDETERMINATE, never auto-matched, no overall_eligibility field of any kind); the three cross-source reconcile checks use RECONCILED/DISCREPANT/INDETERMINATE. A RECOMPUTE only: never a solvency claim, never an audit, never a third-party sign-off, never 'satisfies GENIUS'.

max_as_of_skew_days.description: Optional. Overrides the design-choice threshold (default 10 days, one-third of the GENIUS monthly cadence). A reconcile check whose relevant leg-pair skew exceeds this reads INDETERMINATE.

leg_a.description: Issuer's own published reserve report, extended with a per-asset-class breakdown. Optional; a missing leg drives dependent checks to INDETERMINATE.

as_of.description: ISO date this leg is measured as of. Echoed verbatim, never collapsed with the other legs' dates.

source_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the pasted text/URL this leg cites.

reserves_in_fund_fraction.description: 0-1. Fraction of reserves disclosed as sitting in the Leg B fund. Not assumed to be 1.0 when absent.

asset_breakdown.description: Per-asset-class lines. Capped at 64; an oversized breakdown is refused, never truncated.

asset_class.description: One of the 8 statutory GENIUS eligible-asset enumeration keys, or 'non_eligible' to explicitly declare the line outside the enumeration.

institution.description: Optional. Used only for the OCC NPRM per-institution concentration detail.

leg_b.description: EDGAR N-MFP Part 1 series-level summary only (never Part 3's per-security schedule). Optional; a missing leg drives dependent checks to INDETERMINATE.

leg_c.description: Declared on-chain supply figure. DECLARED input only — no RPC call, no light-client read. Optional; a missing leg drives dependent checks to INDETERMINATE.

not_proven.detail: This tool recomputes arithmetic on disclosed figures; it does not verify the underlying figures are true. Whether Leg A, Leg B, or Leg C's declared numbers are accurate is the declaring party's responsibility, not something this recomputation can determine.
A per-asset-class breakdown that sums correctly to the stated total does not prove the breakdown lists every holding — an omitted line and an inflated line on another can cancel out undetected.
Each leg is a point-in-time figure at its own declared as_of date. No leg is compared against "today" — this tool has no clock.

Per-holding eligible-asset flags report criteria-match only. This tool produces no compliance opinion, no audit, and no examination — a reader wanting one is told this explicitly, never given a merged eligibility boolean.
This tool performs no audit and carries no PCAOB or other audit-firm opinion; it is a recompute-and-reconcile check only.

output_example.determination_note: overall_determination is a worst-of rollup of independent recompute-and-reconcile checks on disclosed figures. It is never a solvency claim, never an audit opinion, and never "satisfies GENIUS" — it states whether recomputed arithmetic, WAM, and three independently-sourced figures are internally consistent with each other, and nothing about whether the declared figures are themselves true.
output_example.regulatory_framework: GENIUS Act reserve-composition recompute (statute-derived eligible-asset enumeration + OCC NPRM concentration/WAM detail, see art-582/art-06/art-275 for the pre-issuance/statutory-restatement/report-timeliness siblings); SEC EDGAR N-MFP Part 1 series summary (U.S. government work, freely usable); not a PCAOB audit, not a third-party sign-off, not an examination.
